mission_result: Implemented executable surplus-capacity discovery deduplication: deterministic SHA-256 fingerprints over canonical root/target/problem/acceptance identity, structured target semantics for owner/scope/privacy/output distinctions, candidate/no-filler/privacy validation, append-only proposal builders, and an atomic create-if-absent filesystem pin reference implementation. Collisions are normal control flow and never overwrite the winner.

evidence.race_result: 5 concurrent pin attempts for one fingerprint -> exactly 1 winner and 4 EEXIST collisions; repeat collision preserved winner bytes
evidence.anti_false_merge_result: structured target is canonical and key-order invariant; changing material owner changes the fingerprint
evidence.authority_result: READY, CURRENT, HUMAN_ACCEPTED and SERVED proposal assertions are rejected; emitted proposal status is always CANDIDATE
evidence.no_filler_result: candidate validation rejects missing durable evidence refs and missing evidence-backed useful-value signals
evidence.privacy_result: obvious credential-bearing public payload shapes are rejected

preserved_prior_contracts: Worker proposals remain immutable candidate evidence, not queue authority.
Text/title similarity alone is insufficient for semantic dedup.
Owner/scope/privacy/output differences must be represented in structured target when material.
Candidate scopes are planning hints and never execution authority.
Collision does not authorize overwrite or duplicate substantive execution.

remaining_boundary.reason: The canonical proposal-claim path coordination/opportunities/proposal-claims/** was not in this opportunity's write scope. The executable filesystem reference proves create-if-absent semantics locally; a future bounded canary should exercise the repository host primitive with explicit write authority.

reusable_next_work_proposals.title: Repository-host discovery pin race canary
reusable_next_work_proposals.problem: The discovery library's atomic reference implementation is tested with fs.open('wx'), but the canonical repository proposal-claim path still needs a host-specific create-if-absent race canary under explicit write scope.
acceptance: two or more concurrent attempts for one fingerprint yield exactly one durable repository pin
losers receive collision evidence and do not overwrite
no queue or authority promotion occurs

return_contract_result: Evidence-backed implementation + checkpoints + explicit remaining boundary + reusable next-work proposal are present.
